reviews.title: Calidad de construcción
reviews.comment: Diez puntos. Los colores no están a la altura de un OLED pero bastante bien
reviews.author: Christian

reviews.title: Poor Quality Control
reviews.comment: Quality control on this monitor is terrible. I ordered five of them and 4 out of 5 had a dead pixel or stuck pixel that could not be fixed. Two of them had multiple dead or stuck pixels in the middle of the screen making them totally unusable. Would not recommend this monitor until the quality control improves.
reviews.author: David

reviews.title: El mejor ips en este rango... si estas dispuesto a moverle la configuración un poco
reviews.comment: Conseguí este monitor a menos de 199 usd, y por ese precio y hasta al rededor de 230 usd no hay competencia en calidad de los colores y contraste, todo ve se impresionante en el y no detecto suttering con la frecuencia variable, pero el calibrado por defecto esta un poco sobresaturado y el brillo máximo tampoco es sobresaliente, así que si no estas dispuesto a calibrarlo un poco o el brillo es un problema para ti, buscaría otras opciones
reviews.author: Alejandro Montoya

reviews.title: Defective panel with dead pixel. Multiple monitor problem.
reviews.comment: Brand new M27Q2 QD, did have damage to the box but that didn't matter. Panel had a dead pixel right out of the box, having owned the monitor for less than 24 hours. Gigabyte manufacture and QC problem. Had a different model and it also had the same issue. Avoid these monitors. Even with the game bundle of RE9 you are still getting a defective panel.
reviews.author: Isaac Fisher
